d:
Shaggy, chin-length ash blonde hair with messy, sweeping bangs. Wide, curious sapphire blue eyes. Appears in the late teens with a youthful, soft face. A lean, slender build. Wears a high-collared cream linen tunic under a light brown leather vest and dark olive trousers. A simple brown leather belt secures the waist.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
